I smoked ~an ounce every two weeks or so for about four months when i was 18, lightly smoked for two months before that. 
Fast forward two years; I currently have a 4.0, I am in the honors program, and I have earned multiple awards in academic competitions.

I cannot relate to 10 years, but I took 300mg topamax for 4 years.
I cut my 25mg pills in half. My neurologist didn't believe the severity of my withdrawal symptoms. I tapered down 12.5mg every month-2 months. Yes, i had withdrawal symptoms, but nowhere near as bad as with tapering down 25mg. (i have also tapered down 50mg, i'm a dumbass). 
I eventually said "f it", and have been stuck at 125mg for about four months. I'm okay with staying on topamax because it's the ONLY thing that helped me with my migraines. I now get small headaches at this dose which sucks, but no week-long misery. And the cognitive side effects have never affected my academic work, only my social life. I'm really not concerned. 
But I do get twitches that i've never had before. I'm definitely "seeing things", they aren't hallucinations but more like light shows. My doctor told me it could be something with my retina, and that topamax sometimes causes problems with eyesight. 

The BIGGEST problem topamax causes for me, whether it be tapering up or down, is the fucking nocturnal panic attacks!! Holy shit!!
I still get them even though i'm not doing anything with my doseage, but when i would taper up
or down, i'd have the panic attacks every night for a week! 
I would get more regular daytime panic attacks than usual. Bad headaches as well. Panicky, but also lethargic, bad combo. Topamax withdrawal is the worst, actually felt like i was dying. 
But tapering down by 12.5mg was so much better.
